traditions.KJV: The proverbs of Solomon .

1.english_reference: A wise son maketh a glad father

traditions.KJV: A wise son maketh a glad father :

1.english_reference: but a foolish son [ is ] the heaviness of his mother

traditions.WLC: וּ בֵ֥ן כְּ֝סִ֗יל תּוּגַ֥ת אִמּֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: υἱὸς δὲ ἄφρων λύπη τῇ μητρί .
traditions.VUL: fílius vero stultus mœstítia est matris suæ .
traditions.KJV: but a foolish son [ is ] the heaviness of his mother .
Treasures of wickedness profit nothing :
but righteousness delivereth from death .

3.english_reference: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish

traditions.VUL: Non afflíget Dóminus fame ánimam iusti ,
traditions.KJV: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish :

3.english_reference: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked

traditions.KJV: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked .

4.english_reference: He becometh poor that dealeth [ with ] a slack hand

traditions.KJV: He becometh poor that dealeth [ with ] a slack hand :

4.english_reference: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich

traditions.KJV: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich .

traditions.LXX: υἱὸς πεπαιδευμένος σοφὸς ἔσται , τῷ δὲ ἄφρονι διακόνῳ χρήσεται .

traditions.VUL: Qui nítitur mendáciis , hic pascit ventos : idem autem ipse séquitur aves volántes .

5.english_reference: He that gathereth in summer [ is ] a wise son

traditions.VUL: Qui cóngregat in messe , fílius sápiens est :
traditions.KJV: He that gathereth in summer [ is ] a wise son : [ but ]

5.english_reference: [ but ] he that sleepeth in harvest [ is ] a son that causeth shame

traditions.LXX: ἀνεμόφθορος δὲ γίνεται ἐν ἀμήτῳ υἱὸς παράνομος .
traditions.VUL: qui autem stertit æstáte , fílius confusiónis .
traditions.KJV: he that sleepeth in harvest [ is ] a son that causeth shame .

6.english_reference: Blessings [ are ] upon the head of the just

traditions.KJV: Blessings [ are ] upon the head of the just :

6.english_reference: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked

traditions.LXX: στόμα δὲ ἀσεβῶν καλύψει πένθος ἄωρον .
traditions.KJV: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked .

7.english_reference: The memory of the just [ is ] blessed

traditions.KJV: The memory of the just [ is ] blessed :

7.english_reference: but the name of the wicked shall rot

traditions.KJV: but the name of the wicked shall rot .

8.english_reference: The wise in heart will receive commandments

traditions.KJV: The wise in heart will receive commandments :

8.english_reference: but a prating fool shall fall

traditions.LXX: ὁ δὲ ἄστεγος χείλεσιν σκολιάζων ὑποσκελισθήσεται .
traditions.KJV: but a prating fool shall fall .

9.english_reference: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely

traditions.KJV: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely :

9.english_reference: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known

traditions.LXX: ὁ δὲ διαστρέφων τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ γνωσθήσεται .
traditions.VUL: qui autem deprávat vias suas , maniféstus erit .
traditions.KJV: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known .

10.english_reference: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow

traditions.LXX: ὁ ἐννεύων ὀφθαλμοῖς μετὰ δόλου συνάγει ἀνδράσι λύπας ,
traditions.KJV: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow :

10.english_reference: but a prating fool shall fall

traditions.LXX: ὁ δὲ ἐλέγχων μετὰ παρρησίας εἰρηνοποιεῖ .
traditions.KJV: but a prating fool shall fall .

11.english_reference: The mouth of a righteous [ man is ] a well of life

traditions.KJV: The mouth of a righteous [ man is ] a well of life :

11.english_reference: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked

traditions.KJV: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked .
Hatred stirreth up strifes :

traditions.WLC: וְ עַ֥ל כָּל פְּ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תְּכַסֶּ֥ה אַהֲבָֽה
traditions.LXX: πάντας δὲ τοὺς μὴ φιλονεικοῦντας καλύπτει φιλία ·
traditions.KJV: but love covereth all sins .

13.english_reference: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found

traditions.KJV: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found :

13.english_reference: but a rod [ is ] for the back of him that is void of understanding

traditions.WLC: וְ֝ שֵׁ֗בֶט לְ גֵ֣ו חֲסַר לֵֽב
traditions.VUL: et virga in dorso eius qui índiget corde .
traditions.KJV: but a rod [ is ] for the back of him that is void of understanding .
Wise [ men ] lay up knowledge :

14.english_reference: but the mouth of the foolish [ is ] near destruction

traditions.VUL: os autem stulti confusióni próximum est .
traditions.KJV: but the mouth of the foolish [ is ] near destruction .

15.english_reference: The rich man ’s wealth [ is ] his strong city

traditions.KJV: The rich man ’s wealth [ is ] his strong city :

15.english_reference: the destruction of the poor [ is ] their poverty

traditions.KJV: the destruction of the poor [ is ] their poverty .

16.english_reference: The labour of the righteous [ tendeth ] to life

traditions.KJV: The labour of the righteous [ tendeth ] to life :

16.english_reference: the fruit of the wicked to sin

traditions.KJV: the fruit of the wicked to sin .

17.english_reference: He [ is in ] the way of life that keepeth instruction

traditions.KJV: He [ is in ] the way of life that keepeth instruction :

17.english_reference: but he that refuseth reproof erreth

traditions.KJV: but he that refuseth reproof erreth .

18.english_reference: He that hideth hatred [ with ] lying lips , and he that uttereth a slander

traditions.WLC: מְכַסֶּ֣ה שִׂ֭נְאָה שִׂפְתֵי שָׁ֑קֶר וּ מוֹצִ֥א דִ֝בָּ֗ה
traditions.LXX: καλύπτουσιν ἔχθραν χείλη δίκαια , οἱ δὲ ἐκφέροντες λοιδορίας
traditions.VUL: Abscóndunt ódium lábia mendácia : qui profert contuméliam ,
traditions.KJV: He that hideth hatred [ with ] lying lips , and he that uttereth a slander , [ is ]
a fool .

19.english_reference: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin

traditions.WLC: בְּ רֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֶחְדַּל פָּ֑שַׁע
traditions.KJV: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin :

19.english_reference: but he that refraineth his lips [ is ] wise

traditions.VUL: qui autem moderátur lábia sua prudentíssimus est .
traditions.KJV: but he that refraineth his lips [ is ] wise .

20.english_reference: The tongue of the just [ is as ] choice silver

traditions.KJV: The tongue of the just [ is as ] choice silver :

20.english_reference: the heart of the wicked [ is ] little worth

traditions.KJV: the heart of the wicked [ is ] little worth .

21.english_reference: The lips of the righteous feed many

traditions.KJV: The lips of the righteous feed many :

21.english_reference: but fools die for want of wisdom

traditions.WLC: וֶֽ֝ אֱוִילִ֗ים בַּ חֲסַר לֵ֥ב יָמֽוּתוּ
traditions.LXX: οἱ δὲ ἄφρονες ἐν ἐνδείᾳ τελευτῶσιν .
traditions.VUL: qui autem indócti sunt , in cordis egestáte moriéntur .
traditions.KJV: but fools die for want of wisdom .

22.english_reference: The blessing of the LORD , it maketh rich

traditions.LXX: εὐλογία Κυρίου ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν δικαίου · αὕτη πλουτίζει ,
traditions.KJV: The blessing of the LORD , it maketh rich ,

22.english_reference: and he addeth no sorrow with it

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא יוֹסִ֖ף עֶ֣צֶב עִמָּֽ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ μὴ προστεθῇ αὐτῇ λύπη ἐν καρδίᾳ .
traditions.KJV: and he addeth no sorrow with it .

23.english_reference: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief

traditions.WLC: כִּ שְׂח֣וֹק לִ֭ כְסִיל עֲשׂ֣וֹת זִמָּ֑ה
traditions.VUL: Quasi per risum stultus operátur scelus :
traditions.KJV: [ It is ] as sport to a fool to do mischief :

23.english_reference: but a man of understanding hath wisdom

traditions.LXX: ἡ δὲ σοφία ἀνδρὶ τίκτει φρόνησιν .
traditions.KJV: but a man of understanding hath wisdom .

24.english_reference: The fear of the wicked , it shall come upon him

traditions.VUL: Quod timet ímpius véniet super eum :
traditions.KJV: The fear of the wicked , it shall come upon him :

24.english_reference: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted

traditions.KJV: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted .

25.english_reference: As the whirlwind passeth , so is the wicked no more

traditions.VUL: Quasi tempéstas tránsiens non erit ímpius :
traditions.KJV: As the whirlwind passeth , so [ is ] the wicked no [ more ] :

traditions.LXX: δίκαιος δὲ ἐκκλίνας σώζεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα .
traditions.KJV: but the righteous [ is ] an everlasting foundation .

traditions.LXX: ὥσπερ ὄμφαξ ὀδοῦσι βλαβερὸν καὶ καπνὸς ὄμμασιν ,
traditions.VUL: Sicut acétum déntibus , et fumus óculis ,
traditions.KJV: As vinegar to the teeth , and as smoke to the eyes ,

traditions.WLC: כֵּ֥ן הֶ֝ עָצֵ֗ל לְ שֹׁלְחָֽי ו
traditions.VUL: sic piger his qui misérunt eum .
traditions.KJV: so [ is ] the sluggard to them that send him .

traditions.KJV: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth .

traditions.KJV: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom :

traditions.KJV: but the froward tongue shall be cut out .
